notes.title: Thank you all!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thanks for the 10,000+ wishlists and, of course, thanks to everyone who bought the game! 
[/b][/h2][h3]We didn't expect so much support on Steam, too; it was a real surprise!  [/h3][h3]We're already working on the next update. If you find any bugs, please report them on [url="https://discord.gg/WPMMum55Hd"]Discord[/url]; we're fixing everything.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527087/33ce16befcf622b555b2a2394eb31129b343ba0a.png"][/img][/h3]
